- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs").     19	func NewRunner(store *store.Store, markdownService markdown.Service) *Runner {
    20		return &Runner{
    21			Store:           store,
    22			MarkdownService: markdownService,
    23		}
    24	}
    25	
    26	// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
    27	func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
    28		// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
    29		const batchSize = 100
    30		offset := 0
    31		processed := 0
    32	
    33		for {
    34			limit := batchSize
    35			memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
    36				Limit:  &limit,
    37				Offset: &offset,
    38			})
    39			if err != nil {
    40				slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
    41				return
    42			}
    43	
    44			// Break if no more memos
    45			if len(memos) == 0 {
    46				break
    47			}
    48	
    49			// Process batch
    50			batchSuccessCount := 0
    51			for _, memo := range memos {
    52				if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
    53					slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
    54					continue
    55				}
    56				if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
    57					ID:      memo.ID,
    58					Payload: memo.Payload,
    59				}); err != nil {
    60					slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
    61					continue
    62				}
    63				batchSuccessCount++
    64			}
    65	
    66			processed += len(memos)
    67			slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)
    68	
    69			// Move to next batch
    70			offset += len(memos)
    71		}
    72	}
    73	
    74	func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
    75		if memo.Payload == nil {
    76			memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
    77		}
    78	
    79		// Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
    80		data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
    81		if err != nil {
    82			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
    83		}
    84	
    85		memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
    86		memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
    87		return nil
    88	}

## Q1 — Derived memo metadata (payload property + snippet)

### Computation site

**`RebuildMemoPayload`** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`
Sets `memo.Payload.Tags` (`:85`) and `memo.Payload.Property` (`:86`) from a single markdown parse; it delegates to `markdownService.ExtractAll` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:80`.

The real extraction is **`(*service).ExtractAll`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` (single goldmark AST walk). A duplicate, property-only implementation exists as **`(*service).ExtractProperties`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:193` (same switch, not used by the rebuild path).

Note `RebuildMemoPayload` does **not** touch `Payload.Location` (user-supplied, set separately at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:112` and `:483`).

### What ExtractAll extracts (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:371-419`)

- `Tags` — `#tag` nodes, excluding tags nested in links/images (`asMemoTagNode`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:134`), deduped case-preserving (`:418`)
- `Mentions` — `@user` nodes, lowercased (`:379-381`), deduped (`:419`)
- `Property.Title` — text of a level-1 heading only if it is the first block child of the document (`:384-389`)
- `Property.HasLink` — any `gast.KindLink` (`:393-394`)
- `Property.HasCode` — `KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, or `KindCodeSpan` (`:396-397`)
- `Property.HasTaskList` — any GFM `TaskCheckBox` (`:399-400`)
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — a task checkbox with `IsChecked == false` (`:401-405`)

### Triggers for recomputation (every call site)

1. **CreateMemo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (before `Store.CreateMemo`)
2. **UpdateMemo**, only when the update mask contains `content` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (result assigned to `update.Payload` at `:451`)
3. **Bulk backfill runner** `(*Runner).RunOnce` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`, rebuilding all memos in batches of 100 and writing each via `UpdateMemo` (`:56`). Note: this runner is **never wired up** — `grep` for `memopayload.NewRunner` finds no caller, and `/bench/repo/server/server.go:163` only starts the s3presign runner.

That's the complete set — there is no other write to `Payload.Tags`/`Payload.Property` anywhere in `server/`, `store/`, or `internal/`. Notably, there is no tag-rename/tag-delete endpoint that recomputes payload (no `RenameMemoTag`/`DeleteMemoTag` in the server tree, even though `markdown.Service.RenameTag` exists at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:425`).

### Snippet (not stored — computed per response)

- `(*service).GenerateSnippet` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:264` (skips fenced/indented code blocks, keeps inline code, re-emits `#tags`, stops at `maxLength*2`)
- Wrapper `(*APIV1Service).getMemoContentSnippet` (64 chars) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83`
- Callers: `convertMemoFromStore` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`; relation snippets in `batchConvertMemoRelations` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:225` and `:248`; notification snippet — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318`

## Q2 — Visibility (PRIVATE/PROTECTED/PUBLIC) enforcement sites

**Core gRPC/Connect memo surfaces**

1. `(*APIV1Service).checkMemoReadAccess` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`, visibility branch at `:55-66` (non-public requires auth; private requires creator). Called from `GetMemo` `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:356` (and again for the parent memo at `:367`) and from `ListMemoComments` `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`.
2. `(*APIV1Service).ListMemos` filter construction — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`: anonymous → `VisibilityList = [PUBLIC]` (`:219`); authed with no creator filter → CEL filter `creator_id == N || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` (`:222-223`); authed browsing another user → `[PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` (`:225`).
3. `(*APIV1Service).ListMemoComments` comment-list filter — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:156-161` (same CEL filter, applied via `FindMemoRelation.MemoFilter`).
4. `(*APIV1Service).ListMemoRelations` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:107-112` (`visibility == "PUBLIC"` for anonymous, else the creator-or-public/protected CEL filter).
5. `(*APIV1Service).CreateMemoComment` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41` (cannot comment on someone else's PRIVATE memo) and `:100` (a comment on another user's memo must not be non-PRIVATE... see `memoComment.Visibility != PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID`); comment inherits parent visibility at `:52`/`:129`.

**Attachment / file serving**

6. `(*FileServerService).checkAttachmentPermission` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650`; visibility logic at `:677` (public + `AllowAnonymous()` → allow), share-token fallback `:684-689`, private gate `:699`. Invoked from the file-serving handler at `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:149`.
7. `(*APIV1Service).checkAttachmentAccess` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422`; memo-visibility gates at `:445` (public → allow), `:448` (non-public requires auth), `:451` (private → creator/superuser). Called from `GetAttachment` `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:256`.
8. `(*APIV1Service).ListMemoAttachments` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-225` (its own inline copy of the same check).

**Reactions**

9. `(*APIV1Service).ListMemoReactions` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-40` (non-public requires auth; private → creator/superuser).
10. `(*APIV1Service).UpsertMemoReaction` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:83`.

**Stats**

11. `(*APIV1Service).ListAllUserStats` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84` and `:90`.
12. `(*APIV1Service).GetUserStats` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:218` and `:220`.

**Realtime / notifications / email**

13. `(*SSEClient).canReceive` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143` (private events only to creator or admin; unknown visibility denied). Event visibility is populated in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go:29-37`.
14. `canViewerAccessMemo` (in-app notifications) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316`, used at `:337`, `:342`, `:370`, `:385`.
15. `canViewerAccessMemo` (email notifications) — `/bench/repo/server/notification/email.go:306-319`, used at `:155` and `:187`.
16. `canUserAccessMentionContext` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-88` (suppresses mention notifications for private memos the mentioned user can't see; `:62`, `:67`, `:84`).

**Anonymous/public read-only surfaces**

17. `(*RSSService).GetExploreRSS` — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `(*RSSService).GetUserRSS` — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:141` (both hard-restrict to `[PUBLIC]`).
18. `(*FrontendService).getSitemapXML` — `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150` (`[PUBLIC]` only).

**Deliberate bypass worth flagging**

`(*APIV1Service).GetMemoByShare` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:153` performs **no** visibility check: a valid, unexpired share token returns the memo regardless of PRIVATE/PROTECTED (only archived/missing are rejected, `:164`). This is the intended counterpart to the `share_token` fallback in `checkAttachmentPermission` (`/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:684`). Share CRUD itself is creator-gated at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:44`, `:93`, `:134`.

Storage layer that these filters compile down to: `FindMemo.VisibilityList` — `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:69`, applied in `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:96-102`, `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:89-95`, `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:104-110`.
